jobs.description:
Our client is building one of the most advanced glass factories in the world in Lommel. This ultramodern site excels in sustainability, automation, and technological innovation. As a TECHNICIAN, you play a key role in the maintenance and operation of this state-of-the-art production environment, where safety, efficiency, and environmental awareness are at the forefront.

Jobomschrijving

Well before the startup, you will begin thorough training in day shifts to fully understand our installations, systems, and standards, enabling you to help set the standard in this unique factory from day one.

Depending on your background (electrical or mechanical), you will be deployed as a technician within one of the maintenance teams. Your tasks will include:
	
• Analyzing and resolving technical faults in machines and installations	
• Performing preventive and corrective maintenance	
• Calibrating, adjusting, and checking parts and systems	
• Contributing ideas for technical improvements within your department	
• Working closely with fellow technicians and operators for safe and stable operation	
• Accurately recording interventions in the maintenance system

Profile:
	
• You have completed technical training or have relevant experience in maintenance	
• You are strong in mechanical and/or electrical areas	
• You are solution-oriented and enjoy working in a team	
• You are skilled in reading technical plans or schematics	
• You can work in a day-shift and are looking for a stable, long-term challenge	
• You speak good English.

Our client is building one of the most advanced glass factories in the world in Lommel. This ultramodern site excels in sustainability, automation, and technological innovation. As a TECHNICIAN, you play a key role in the maintenance and operation of this state-of-the-art production environment, where safety, efficiency, and environmental awareness are at the forefront.

Jobomschrijving

Well before the startup, you will begin thorough training in day shifts to fully understand our installations, systems, and standards, enabling you to help set the standard in this unique factory from day one.

Depending on your background (electrical or mechanical), you will be deployed as a technician within one of the teams. Your tasks will include:
	
• Maintenance and monitoring of electrical systems, such as switchboards, electrical installations, and emergency repairs;	
• Supervision of gas installations, ensuring safety and proper functioning of these systems;	
• Maintenance of HVAC systems (Heating, Ventilation, Air Conditioning), ensuring adequate temperature and air quality in buildings;	
• Diagnostics and repair of heating systems.

Profile:
	
• You have completed technical training and have relevant experience 	
• You are strong in mechanical and/or electrical areas	
• You are solution-oriented and enjoy working in a team	
• You are skilled in reading technical plans or schematics	
• You can work in a 6-shift system and are looking for a stable, long-term challenge	
• You speak good English.

Onze klant, een biotech bedrijf, gevestigd in Zwijnaarde, is een wereldwijd biotechnologiebedrijf dat de innovatieve CAR-T celtheraptie naar Gent brengt. Het bedrijf maakt hiermee dagdagelijks het verschil in het leven van vele patiënten die lijden aan kanker en andere levensbedreigende ziektes.
Ze zijn momenteel in een fase van sterke groei en zoeken gemotiveerde en toegewijde teamleden. 

Jobomschrijving

We’re looking for skilled individuals to join our mission of transforming medicine. This is more than just a job—it’s an opportunity to advance your career in a dynamic, purpose-driven environment. Whether you have a secondary education with hands-on experience or are a recent graduate with a bachelor’s degree in life sciences or related fields—and especially if you’ve worked in cleanrooms, pharmaceutical manufacturing, or chemical processing—we’d love to hear from you.

We are looking for dedicated process operators to join our team at a leading biotechnology company. What can you expect in this exciting role?

Your journey begins with extensive training, where we immerse you in the world of aseptic (germ-free) and GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) operations, including the crucial procedures you need to master.

Afterward, you will join our dynamic and driven Operations team, which works together every day to fulfill our mission. Alongside your fellow operators and team leaders, you will perform aseptic and manual production processes according to strict, proven procedures.

Daily aseptic and manual production processes

Working in a cleanroom lab environment

Executing production steps in controlled environments (grade A/B/C/D) such as spiking, media changes, cell culture, and freezing therapeutic products.

Managing equipment: inspections and maintenance

Thorough cleaning and disinfection of materials

Supporting transitions between production zones

Ensuring patients receive high-quality therapies on time

A strong sense of responsibility and passion to make a difference in the lives of patients.

Clear verbal and written communication skills with an attention to detail and the ability to follow procedures.

You thrive in fast-paced environments and are eager to learn and grow in advanced biomanufacturing.

You like structure and order, are very accurate and are willing to work in an aseptic environment with appropriate sterile clothing.

You have a relevant 'graduaat' or a bachelor’s degree. Alternatively, if you hold a secondary education diploma and have initial experience in a lab or cleanroom or hospital environment, pharmaceutical manufacturing, chemical processing, or similar regulated industries you are also eligible.

You are willing to work in a shift regime 4 days of working 4 days.

You speak very good English.

You’re excited to work with cutting-edge equipment and technologies

Our client is a well-established manufacturer of high-quality coffins, supplying products with a strong focus on craftsmanship, precision, and quality. To strengthen the production team in Drongen, we are looking for a motivated Machine Operator for the carpentry department.

Jobomschrijving

As a Machine Operator in the carpentry department, you will be responsible for various woodworking and production tasks, including:
	
• Operating planing, sawing, and gluing machines	
• Processing and assembling wooden components	
• Performing quality checks on finished products	
• Ensuring production targets and quality standards are met	
• Maintaining a clean and safe working environment

We are looking for someone who:
	
• Has experience operating production or woodworking machines	
• Has forklift experience or a valid forklift certificate (an advantage)	
• Is not afraid of physical work	
• Can communicate in Dutch, English, or French (Polish is also welcome)	
• Is reliable, motivated, and quality-conscious

Our client specializes in bodywork and mechanical repairs for all car brands.

Jobomschrijving

Our client is looking for a skilled tinsmith to join their team. You will be responsible for the repair, maintenance, and installation of metal components. As a tinsmith you will play a key role in restoring and repairing vehicles or metal structures.

 

Your Responsibilities:
	
• Performing sheet metal work, including repairing damaged parts.	
• Installing and removing body panels, metal coverings, or structural components.	
• Metal processing (bending, straightening, cutting, welding).	
• Preparing surfaces for painting or further treatment.	
• Following safety regulations and maintaining a clean workspace.

Candidate Profile:
	
• Minimum 2 years of experience as a tinsmith.	
• Proficiency in using sheet metal tools (hammers, welding machines, grinders, etc.).	
• Knowledge of materials and techniques used in sheet metal work.	
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.	
• Attention to detail and precision in executing tasks.	
• Communicative knowledge of English or Dutch.

Our client is active in the service industry.

Jobomschrijving

 Your responsabilities will be : 
 
* Manage incoming emails and correspondence
 * Monitor and coordinate client bookings
 * Ensure the administrative follow-up of a portfolio of many clients
 * Organize travel, accommodation, and other arrangements for clients
 * Provide support to a diverse range of businesses and industries
 * Assist with management and executive support tasks
 * Provide reception back-up and front-office support
 * Handle various administrative and organizational duties

• Proficient knowledge of English and French required (Dutch is a plus)
• Ability to manage multiple priorities
• Service-minded attitude
• Experience in front desk operations and administration
• Passion for working in a premium hospitality environment
• Adaptable and flexible
• Strong dedication and reliability

Our client is the world's largest vertically integrated manufacturer of polyurethane foams. The company serves a diverse global marketplace with innovative polyurethane chemical solutions, polyester fibers, and insulation materials. With a network of more than 60 production facilities worldwide, our client has established itself as a global industry leader, recognized for its high-quality products, advanced manufacturing technologies, and commitment to employee development.

Jobomschrijving

As a Machine Operator, you will be responsible for:
	
• Operating and setting up production machines according to production guidelines and specifications.	
• Cutting and processing foam blocks based on customer and production requirements.	
• Performing quality checks on finished products, including dimensions, shape, color, and compliance with specifications.	
• Using measuring tools during the production process.	
• Registering production data and labeling products in the Carpy system.	
• Transporting materials and products between workstations using an electric pallet truck.	
• Ensuring the proper operation of machinery and carrying out basic maintenance tasks when required.

Requirements
	
• Previous experience in a production or manufacturing environment.	
• Technical aptitude and an interest in operating machinery.	
• Ability to work independently with a strong sense of responsibility and attention to quality.	
• Good teamwork and communication skills.	
• Working knowledge of English or Dutch sufficient for workplace communication.

The company is located in Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

As a Finance Officer your responsibilities are:

• Manage daily financial transactions and maintain accurate records.
• Prepare and review financial statements and reports.
• Ensure compliance with financial regulations and standards.
• Support month-end and year-end financial closing processes.
• Collaborate with internal teams to manage budgets and forecasts.
• Monitor accounts payable and receivable processes.
• Assist in audits and implement recommendations as required.
• Provide financial analysis and insights to support decision-making.

A successful Finance Officer should have:

• Educational background in accounting, finance, or a related field.
• Residence in Brussels/Belgium.
• Valid EU work permit.
• Proficiency in financial software and tools.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Attention to detail and accuracy in financial reporting.
• Ability to communicate effectively in both English and French.

Our client is a leading player in the financial services sector, known for its strong customer orientation, professional development opportunities, and collaborative culture. The company invests heavily in its employees and offers a stable environment where talent can grow and develop.

Jobomschrijving

• Build and maintain strong relationships with customers.
• Advise clients on products and services that match their needs.
• Support customers throughout their journey and provide excellent service.
• Identify commercial opportunities and contribute to business growth.
• Work closely with colleagues to ensure an outstanding customer experience.
• Participate in client meetings, follow-ups, and sales initiatives.

• Master's degree (field of study is not important).
• Fluent in French, Dutch, and English.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• Commercial mindset with a genuine interest in sales and customer relationships.
• Proactive, dynamic, and eager to learn.
• Team player with a positive attitude.

We are looking for an experienced and motivated Packaging Supervisor to join the  team on the night shift. 

Your responsibilities:

• Supervise and coordinate the packaging team during the night shift.

• Ensure that packaging activities are carried out efficiently and according to production planning.

• Follow and maintain the work schedule

• Lead and coordinate team members

• Actively contribute to the work on the floor

• Work responsibly, flexibly, and independently

 

 

Requirements:

• Previous experience in a packaging, production, or supervisory role.

• Strong organizational and leadership skills.

• Ability to work independently and make decisions under pressure.

• Willingness to work night shifts.

• Experience in a food production or manufacturing environment is an advantage.

• Good command of English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

jobs.description:
Our client is a company specialised in technical solutions for construction projects, active across a wide range of sites in Belgium. It relies on an internal engineering team responsible for analysing, optimising, and preparing the technical aspects of projects. To support its development, the organisation is strengthening its design office with a Dutch-speaking engineer.

Jobomschrijving

• Contribute to the technical analysis of projects and the preparation of offers
• Explore different design approaches and propose suitable technical solutions
• Collaborate with internal teams to assess constraints, risks, and opportunities
• Support the preparation of technical documents and project files
• Take responsibility for complete technical studies related to project design and execution
• Provide technical support to operational teams during project start-up and follow-up
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of methods, tools, and processes within the design office
• Work on projects requiring in-depth technical or structural analysis.

• Civil or industrial engineer with a strong interest in technical analysis and design
• Fluent in Dutch, with a good understanding of English and French
• Rigorous, analytical, and comfortable with calculations and modelling
• Enjoys teamwork and contributing to varied projects
• Motivated to grow in an environment where technique, precision, and collaboration are essential

Our client is an innovative manufacturing company seeking an experienced engineering professional to strengthen its operations and accelerate continuous improvement projects.

Jobomschrijving

• Lead and execute manufacturing improvement and process optimization projects while managing multiple priorities.
• Identify production bottlenecks, implement practical solutions, and deliver measurable operational improvements.
• Drive automation initiatives by evaluating, improving, and supporting industrial control systems and automation solutions.
• Provide technical expertise to production, quality, maintenance, and commercial teams, including support for quality issues and new product feasibility assessments.
• Ensure projects are delivered on time, aligned with business objectives, and contribute to long-term operational excellence.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical, Electromechanical, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field.
• Proven experience in a manufacturing or production environment with expertise in project management, process optimization, automation, and continuous improvement.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with a hands-on mindset and the ability to prioritize and deliver quick results.
• Good knowledge of SolidWorks and experience working with industrial machinery and manufacturing processes.
• Fluent in English with excellent communication skills; additional languages are considered an asset.

An organisation operating in the industrial/manufacturing industry based in Wijnegem. Accessible by car and public transportation.

Jobomschrijving

As a Supply Chain Officer your responsibilities are:

• Coordinate procurement activities to ensure timely delivery of goods and services.
• Monitor inventory levels and manage stock replenishment processes effectively.
• Ensure compliance with procurement policies and procedures.
• Collaborate with internal departments to forecast demand and plan supply accordingly.
• Organizing transportation of raw materials and finished goods.
• Analyse and optimise supply chain processes to improve efficiency.
• Handle documentation and administrative tasks related to procurement and supply chain management.

A successful Supply Chain Officer should have:

• A strong understanding of procurement and supply chain processes.
• Experience in the industrial/manufacturing sector is beneficial.
• Excellent organisational and problem-solving skills.
• Strong communication and negotiation abilities.
• Professional proficiency in English and French. 
• Attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively.

Working at Michael Page means joining an entrepreneurial, fast-paced, and performance-driven environment where consultants are empowered to develop their own client portfolio, advise businesses on talent strategies, and make a real impact on people's careers. The company promotes a culture of teamwork, integrity, meritocracy, and continuous career development.

Jobomschrijving

As a Recruitment Consultant your responsibilities are:

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients and candidates.
• Identify and source top talent through various recruitment methods.
• Manage the full recruitment cycle, from job briefing to offer negotiation.
• Provide expert advice to clients on market trends and hiring strategies.
• Screen, interview, and assess candidates for suitability.
• Ensure a high standard of service delivery to both clients and candidates.

A successful Recruitment Consultant should have:

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• An ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively.
• Fluency in English and French OR Dutch.
• Passion for sales, recruitment, and business development
• A proactive mindset.

Our client is a major real estate and infrastructure organization managing large-scale public-private partnership projects focused on the development, operation, and long-term maintenance of public facilities.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage a portfolio of approximately 25 building projects, coordinating maintenance activities and ensuring smooth collaboration between clients, contractors, and other stakeholders.
• Act as the main point of contact for administrative, technical, contractual, insurance, and damage-related matters, while mediating conflicts and facilitating mutually acceptable solutions.
• Coordinate maintenance requests, technical inspections, change requests, and interventions through a dedicated helpdesk and ensure proper follow-up with the relevant parties.
• Monitor the technical condition, regulatory compliance, and overall performance of the buildings, including annual condition assessments based on NEN 2767 standards and follow-up of corrective actions.
• Prepare and maintain accurate documentation, meeting reports, and records in the document management system, while supporting stakeholders in improving the energy efficiency of the buildings.

• Bachelor's degree in Construction Engineering, Facility Management, Real Estate, or equivalent professional experience, with 3-5 years of relevant experience in maintenance, technical consultancy, or real estate.
• Strong knowledge of building technical systems and maintenance requirements, ideally gained through experience with schools, offices, hospitals, or other large public/commercial buildings.
• Excellent communication, consultation, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to mediate conflicts and build strong professional relationships.
• Proactive, customer-oriented, highly organized, and solution-driven, with strong attention to detail and the ability to work independently as well as within multidisciplinary teams.
• Fluent in Dutch, with a good command of French and English, and proficient in MS Office and technical/construction documentation tools such as CAD and relevant maintenance or project-management applications.

About this job
Are you comfortable taking the lead in a production environment? Do you enjoy combining people management with a strong focus on quality and efficiency? For a growing company, we are looking for a Packaging Team Leader to strengthen the operations team.
Jouw verantwoordelijkheden
In this role, you ensure that the packaging department operates smoothly from start to finish.

• Prepare and organize the daily packaging activities.
• Guide employees and distribute tasks across the team.
• Keep a close eye on product quality, hygiene and safety procedures.
• Follow up on packaging orders and coordinate priorities.
• Act quickly when technical or operational issues occur.
• Look for practical ways to improve efficiency on the production floor.
• Maintain clear communication with production planning and finished goods storage.
• Keep the Production Manager informed about progress and possible challenges.
• Help introduce and optimize the use of MES and ERP systems within the department.

• A first experience in production is preferred; experience in the food industry is a strong advantage.
• You are confident when guiding colleagues and making decisions on the work floor.
• A practical mindset and a flexible attitude come naturally to you.
• You work accurately and have an eye for quality and detail.
• Good English communication skills are required.
• You are comfortable using computer systems and willing to learn new software.
• Working in two shifts fits your availability.

About this job
For a foodcompany in Meulebeke, we are looking for a line supervisor for a 2-shift schedule.
Jouw verantwoordelijkheden
You will start up the production process, operate the machines, and oversee smooth operations. In case of malfunctions, you will troubleshoot them or call in a technician. You follow the production planning and ensure efficient communication with colleagues. Additionally, you actively participate on the production floor.

What are we looking for?

• You are able to work very independently
• You have a strong sense of responsibility and know how to take action
• You have some technical insight
• You have a good knowledge of English or Dutch
• You are willing to work in 2 shifts
• It is a plus if you can operate a forklift

Step into the world of biotechnology and be part of a dynamic team! Legend Biotech, a leading biotechnology company, is looking for 
Cleaning Operators for their laboratory. You will be thoroughly
 trained in aseptic (germ-free) and GMP work and related procedures before joining our professional team. As a 
Cleaning Operator, you will be responsible for 
keeping the assigned areas and production zones within the laboratory spotlessly clean. You will ensure the maintenance of the equipment used and clean and disinfect materials with the highest accuracy. You handle cleaning products and materials in 
a safe and correct manner. The laboratory works with biological products in a strictly temperature-controlled environment, where 
human lives depend on your diligence.

 
• Order and cleanliness are of great importance to you.
 
• Possible experience in an environment that needs to be kept clean is a plus
 
• An enthusiastic team player, you can work both accurately and independently.
 
• You have a good command of the Dutch or English language.
 
• Wearing a sterile suit and strict adherence to procedures are no problem for you.
